shared_elements: low-relief carved motifs repeated in a row
repeating rounded/arched forms in a sequence
justification: Both surfaces show shallow relief motifs repeated in sequence along a band, which is the only real correspondence, and it is a near-universal decorative habit. What is depicted differs entirely: A is a vegetal scheme of palmettes and lotus-like blossoms on stems in a continuous vertical scroll, while B shows registers of animal-like bodies (rounded quadruped/bird forms above, elongated creatures below), with no plant content at all.
